title: The Two Sorrows of the Luminaries and the Joy at the End
description: No man — and not even the great luminaries, sun and moon — rejoices wholly in the present cosmos, because two corruptions are visible from their fixed station: the King of Darkness enthroned where he does not belong, and the Living Soul afflicted and transmigrated body to body (the Cross of Light read through the eyes of the heavenly witnesses). When the soul is redeemed and the enemy bound at the end, this grief gives way to permanent joy.
